fields.description: The channel-specific address: an email, a phone number with country code, a Telegram chat id...
fields.label: Address / Identifier

fields.description: Optional: restrict this address to one message category (e.g. a separate promotional email). Blank = any category.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: When this address was last confirmed: a click on its confirmation link, or a provider reporting the message delivered.
fields.label: Verified On

fields.description: Show this address to other members in a people directory. Off unless the person turns it on. The only reader today is the Alumni Directory, which also requires the alumnus's own "Show in Directory" and a verified address (ADR 070).
fields.label: Share in Directory

fields.description: Who put this row here. Only "Self-service" rows may be edited or removed by the person on the portal; everything else — including the blank of a row that predates this field — is the school's and stays locked (ADR 070).
fields.label: Source
